style.head: <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&display=swap"><style>:root{--j2-primary:#4F2BD9;--j2-secondary:#0F172A;--j2-accent:#FF6B1A;--j2-background:#F6F4FF;--j2-surface:#FFFFFF;--j2-text:#0F172A;--j2-muted:#475569;--j2-font-heading:'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;--j2-font-body:'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;--j2-space:8px;--j2-section:56px;--j2-radius:12px;}body{margin:0;font-family:var(--j2-font-body);color:var(--j2-text);background:var(--j2-background)}h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--j2-font-heading)}.j2-btn{display:inline-block;background:#4F2BD9;color:#FFFFFF;border:2px solid #4F2BD9;font-weight:700;min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}.j2-btn-secondary{display:inline-block;background:#FFFFFF;color:#4F2BD9;border:2px solid #4F2BD9;font-weight:700;min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}.j2-card{background:#FFFFFF;border:2px solid #0F172A;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 #FF6B1A}</style>

W-15.head: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
W-15.body:
<style id="j2-style">
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){html{scroll-behavior:smooth}}
html,body{max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip}
body{margin:0;padding-top:60px;font-family:var(--j2-font-body,'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--j2-text,#0F172A);background:var(--j2-background,#F6F4FF)}
img,svg,video,iframe,table{max-width:100%}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--j2-font-heading,'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif);line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 .5em;color:var(--j2-secondary,#0F172A);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,8vw,3.75rem);color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9);letter-spacing:-.02em}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.65rem,5.5vw,2.375rem)}
h2::after{content:"";display:block;width:56px;height:6px;margin-top:10px;background:var(--j2-accent,#FF6B1A);border-radius:3px}
h3{font-size:1.25rem}
p,li,dd,dt,label,td,th,a,summary{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
a{color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9);text-underline-offset:3px}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1B0F6B;outline-offset:2px}
[hidden],.hidden,.is-hidden{display:none!important}

section[id]{padding:var(--j2-section,56px) 16px;background:#FFFFFF;scroll-margin-top:72px;max-width:100%}
section[id]:nth-of-type(even){background:var(--j2-background,#F6F4FF)}
section[id]>*{max-width:1100px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
@media (min-width:768px){section[id]{padding-left:32px;padding-right:32px}}

#hero{background:#F6F4FF;border-bottom:8px solid var(--j2-accent,#FF6B1A);padding-top:48px;padding-bottom:56px}
#hero p{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600}
.hero-cta{min-height:52px;padding:14px 28px;font-size:1.125rem;margin-top:8px}

.j2-btn,.j2-btn-secondary{min-height:44px;max-width:100%;text-align:center;font-family:inherit;font-size:1rem}
button.j2-btn,button.j2-btn-secondary{cursor:pointer}
.j2-card{min-width:0;max-width:100%}

#site-nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;width:100%;z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--j2-secondary,#0F172A);overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;white-space:nowrap;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
#site-nav>*{flex-shrink:0}
#site-nav ul{display:flex;gap:4px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
#site-nav .nav-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:999px;color:#FFFFFF;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;flex-shrink:0}
#site-nav .nav-link:hover{background:#27324F}
#site-nav .nav-link.active{background:var(--j2-accent,#FF6B1A);color:#0F172A}
#site-nav .nav-link:focus-visible{outline-color:#FFFFFF}

#contrast-bar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding:8px 16px;background:#E4DEFF;max-width:100%}
#contrast-toggle{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;padding:8px 18px;border:2px solid var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9);border-radius:var(--j2-radius,12px);background:#FFFFFF;color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9);font:700 1rem var(--j2-font-body,'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif);cursor:pointer}
#contrast-toggle[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--j2-secondary,#0F172A);color:#FFFFFF}

:has(>.cd-unit){display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.cd-unit{min-width:0;text-align:center;padding:12px 4px;background:var(--j2-secondary,#0F172A);color:#FFFFFF;border-radius:var(--j2-radius,12px);font-size:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.cd-unit span,.cd-unit strong,.cd-unit b{display:block;font-family:var(--j2-font-heading,'Space Grotesk',sans-serif);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,7vw,2.75rem);line-height:1.1;color:var(--j2-accent,#FF6B1A)}

.track-card,.prize-item,.sched-item,.fee-row,.faq-item{margin:0 0 16px;min-width:0}
:has(>.track-card),:has(>.prize-item){display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
:has(>.track-card)>.track-card,:has(>.prize-item)>.prize-item{margin:0}
@media (min-width:768px){:has(>.track-card),:has(>.prize-item){grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px}}
.track-card h3{color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9)}
.prize-item{background:#FFFFFF;border:2px solid var(--j2-secondary,#0F172A);border-radius:var(--j2-radius,12px);padding:20px;font-weight:600}
.fee-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px 16px;padding:14px 16px;background:#FFFFFF;border:2px solid var(--j2-secondary,#0F172A);border-radius:var(--j2-radius,12px);font-weight:600}
.sched-item{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 16px;padding:12px 16px;background:#FFFFFF;border-left:6px solid var(--j2-accent,#FF6B1A);border-radius:8px}
.sched-item strong,.sched-item time{min-width:84px;color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9);font-weight:700}
:has(>.sched-item){display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0 24px}
table{width:100%;table-layout:fixed;border-collapse:collapse}
th,td{padding:10px 8px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #CBD5E1}

form{display:grid;gap:16px;max-width:640px}
label{display:block;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
input,select,textarea{display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:10px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:1rem;color:var(--j2-text,#0F172A);background:#FFFFFF;border:2px solid #334155;border-radius:8px}
input[type="checkbox"],input[type="radio"]{display:inline-block;width:24px;height:24px;min-height:0;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9)}
output,#calc-total{display:block;font-family:var(--j2-font-heading,'Space Grotesk',sans-serif);font-size:clamp(1.75rem,7vw,2.5rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9)}
[id$="-error"],.field-error,.error{color:#B00020;font-weight:600;margin:6px 0 0}
form button[type="submit"],form button:not([type]){min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border:2px solid var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9);border-radius:var(--j2-radius,12px);background:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9);color:#FFFFFF;font:700 1rem var(--j2-font-body,'Inter',sans-serif);cursor:pointer}

.faq-item{background:#FFFFFF;border:2px solid var(--j2-secondary,#0F172A);border-radius:var(--j2-radius,12px);padding:0 16px}
.faq-item summary{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;padding:8px 0;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.faq-item[open] summary{color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9)}
.faq-item p{margin:0 0 14px}

:has(>.sponsor-logo){display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,150px),1fr));gap:16px}
.sponsor-logo,.photo-placeholder{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;min-width:0;max-width:100%;padding:12px;background:#EEF0FF;color:#334155;border:2px dashed #4F2BD9;border-radius:var(--j2-radius,12px);font-weight:600}
.sponsor-logo{min-height:88px}
.photo-placeholder{aspect-ratio:4/3}
:has(>.photo-placeholder){display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
@media (min-width:768px){:has(>.photo-placeholder){grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}

.contact-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:8px 4px;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--j2-primary,#4F2BD9)}
</style>

W-6.body:
Register your team

One form per team, filled in by the team lead. Submitting opens your email app with your details addressed to register@example.com. Press send there to finish. All fields are required. College name appears for Student tickets, and dietary preference appears when you choose meal passes.

Optional, Rs 200 each.

W-7.body:
Become a mentor

Want to help teams build? Sign up as a mentor. Submitting opens your email app with your details addressed to mentors@example.com. Press send there to finish. All fields are required.

Do I need my own laptop?

Yes.

Yes, we will match you with a team on day one.
